retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical grid of four men in formal attire standing inside upright caskets against a tiled background, framed by floral wreaths.
excludeWhen: a realistic funeral scene is requested
a single subject portrait is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly structured, symmetrical composition featuring four vertical caskets arranged in a row. Each casket contains a man in a tuxedo, with the top half showing the person and the bottom half reflecting a candle flame. The scene is bookended by floral sprays at the top and bottom of each casket, set against a grid-like tiled wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Four-fold vertical symmetry across the horizontal plane
Contrast between formal black tuxedos and pastel casket linings
Repetition of floral motifs at the head and foot of each unit
coreInvariants: Upright vertical orientation of the caskets
Reflective lower panels on the caskets showing candle light

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects of equal scale distributed evenly across the frame, occupying the central vertical band.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The four faces of the men, positioned at the upper-middle third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A rhythmic horizontal scan across the four identical vertical units, moving from the top floral sprays down to the bottom wreaths.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The tiled wall provides a textured but neutral negative space that reinforces the grid structure.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pastel pink, yellow, and blue (casket linings and flowers)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark suits and the glowing candle reflections.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a slightly desaturated, vintage film look

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif or heavy block sans
letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are compressed to fit the width of the casket row
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy weight used for all text to maintain a monolithic block feel.
graphicDevices: Grid lines from the background tiles
Rectangular framing of the casket lids

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky presence and tight spacing.
Provides the slab-serif feel seen in many 70s rock albums.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide shot of four men in black tuxedos standing inside four upright caskets. The caskets are lined with pastel fabrics (pink, cream, blue, yellow). Each casket has a large floral arrangement on top and a wreath at the bottom. The background is a wall of small square teal tiles. The bottom half of each casket is a dark reflective panel showing a single candle flame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, heavy block text in a muted olive-gold color at the top center, spanning the width of the four caskets. The text should be semi-transparent to blend with the tile texture.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a heavy, blocky appearance?
Are the floral arrangements present at both top and bottom?

mustRedesign: Specific faces of the original band members
postGenerationChecks: Check for four distinct vertical units
Verify the presence of candle reflections in the lower panels
Ensure the floral wreaths are symmetrical
Confirm the text is centered and heavy-weighted
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Grid + Macabre Subject + Formal Attire + Floral Framing
